note: Documented V2 privilege decisions that differ from the legacy storage-authority manifest (source of truth: apps/union-eyes/scripts/bootstrap-v2/current-authority.ts). Kept as data, not code, because naming a table in a reachable module would make the production-reachability ratchet count this contract as a use of the table.

entries.decision: Organization-owned operational metadata with a UUID organization FK; authenticated CRUD under organization RLS. Does not qualify the separate financial database.
The evidence pack builder saves the manifest and seals the pack by UPDATE inside the authenticated organization.
